metadata.description: Claude Code mods by MHermand: agents-progress, a subagents progress bar with a mascot per model that powers up from Haiku to Fable; usage-limits, your plan usage limits and pace above the prompt.

plugins.name: agents-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt whenever subagents run, a mascot per model, and the list of subagents with steps, cost, tokens and time.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Mod: a slim band above the prompt with your plan usage limits, the 5-hour session and the week: how much is used, when each resets, and whether your pace reaches the limit before then; alerts at 75% and 90%.
